sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美美元金融中枢、私人利益基金会（PIF）与运河船舶登记

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Digital Webtoon Publishing and Multilingual Chapter Unlocking

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Unitary national legal system grounded in the civil law tradition, with significant North American influence in corporate, maritime, banking, and securities statutes; the Sociedad Anónima is governed by Cabinet Decree 194 of 1987, as amended, and Law 32 of 1927
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Trade Promotion Agreement between the Republic of Panama and the United States of America (TPA), entered into force 31 October 2012 (includes Chapter 10 on Investment)
Bilateral Investment Treaty between the Republic of Panama and the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland (in force)
Convention between the Republic of Panama and the Republic of Korea for the Avoidance of Double Taxation (in force)
Convention between the Republic of Panama and the Kingdom of the Netherlands for the Avoidance of Double Taxation (in force)
Multilateral Convention to Implement Tax Treaty Related Measures to Prevent Base Erosion and Profit Shifting (BEPS MLI), signed by Panama under the OECD/G20 Inclusive Framework

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley No. 23 de 27 de abril de 2015 (AML/CFT framework), as amended by Ley No. 70 de 2019 and Ley No. 2 de 2018 (immobilization of bearer shares and transparency of legal persons); Decreto de Gabinete No. 511 de 3 de diciembre de 2019 (Central Beneficial Ownership Registry, 25% threshold, government-only access); Decreto Ejecutivo No. 363 de 30 de octubre de 2015 (implementing regulations on customer due diligence, record-keeping and reporting); Cabinet Decree No. 194 de 1987 (General Law of Corporations), Articles 6-10 (resident agent obligations to identify and verify beneficial owners); Superintendencia de Sujetos No Financieros (SSRF) Resolution No. 005-2020 (beneficial ownership filing procedures)
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access (Central Beneficial Ownership Registry administered by the SSRF; data is confidential, accessible only to designated supervisory, law enforcement, and tax authorities; not open to public inspection)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Individual due-diligence file for each natural-person UBO, director and authorized signatory: certified copy of the passport (photo page) and proof of residential address
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport-issuing government authority of the UBO's country of nationality, or a Panamanian notary public for certified copies
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille issued by the competent authority of the issuing state; for states not party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention, full consular legalization through the Panamanian consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing (Certificado de Vigencia) or current registry extract for any corporate shareholder of the Panama S.A.
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-country companies registry (e.g., mercantile registry, Companies House, or equivalent competent corporate register of the shareholder's jurisdiction)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization as applicable under the origin jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized and apostilled Power of Attorney (Poder) appointing the Panamanian licensed resident agent and incorporation counsel to execute and register the articles of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public of the UBO's or shareholder's country of domicile
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille by the competent authority of the notary's jurisdiction; consular legalization if the notary is located in a non-Hague Convention state

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Criminal records certificate (Certificado de Antecedentes Penales / police clearance) for each natural-person UBO and director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National police, criminal records bureau, or judicial authority of the UBO's country of residence; for Panamanian residents, the Archivo Central de Antecedentes Policiales
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization; if issued in Panama, authentication by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, and authorized signatories before incorporation against (i) the UN Consolidated Sanctions Lists (Resolutions 1267/1989/2231), (ii) the OFAC SDN List, (iii) the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, (iv) the Panamanian National Commission against Money Laundering (CNV) and Financial Analysis Unit (UAF) indicators, and (v) FATF/GAFILAT public statements. PEP identification follows FATF Recommendation 12 and Law 23/2015: any person holding a prominent public position, or related to such person, triggers enhanced due diligence, senior-management approval, documented source-of-funds evidence, and ongoing monitoring for the duration of the relationship plus a tail period of at least 12 months after declassification. Any affirmative sanctions match or unexplained adverse media finding requires immediate Suspicious Activity Report filing to the UAF within 24 hours and mandatory rejection or restructuring of the proposed incorporation.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Público de Panamá - Sede Electrónica / Portal de Trámites en Línea (https://www.registropublico.gob.pa)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The official operating language of the Panamanian Public Registry is Spanish. A proposed corporate name must be expressed in Latin-script characters; names originating in non-Latin scripts (e.g., Chinese, Cyrillic, Arabic) must be phonetically transliterated into the Spanish/Latin alphabet. The name must not be identical to, or confusingly similar to, an existing registered company name or a trademark recorded in the Panamanian registry, and must be followed by the term 'Sociedad Anónima' or the abbreviation 'S.A.' in the corporate denomination.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: The name reservation is valid for 30 calendar days and may not be automatically extended; upon expiration the requester must submit a fresh search and reservation request through the portal. If the Mercantile Registry rejects the proposed name, counsel may file a written recurso de apelación before the Director General of the Registro Público within 5 business days of notification. If the appeal is denied, a recurso de reconsideración may be filed within 3 business days of the appellate decision. A final administrative denial may be challenged through a demanda contencioso-administrativa filed with the Third Chamber (Sala Tercera) of the Supreme Court of Justice within 2 months of the final administrative act. Pending appeal, a distinct alternative name should be reserved to avoid transactional delay.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Acceptable for the digital-webtoon publishing industry: no operational brick-and-mortar presence is required under Panamanian corporate law. The statutory registered office must be maintained at the office of the mandatory licensed resident agent in Panama; virtual or remote operational set-ups are permissible provided the resident agent retains the corporate records, the UBO file is current and complete, and the company can evidence Panamanian-source versus foreign-source income allocation if audited by the Dirección General de Ingresos under the territorial tax regime.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Nominal annual risk for a low-risk digital publisher with a complete UBO file and timely SSRF filings: approximately 5% probability of an unannounced physical inspection in the first year. The SSRF, the Dirección General de Ingresos, and the Public Registry each hold statutory authority to conduct unannounced inspections of the registered office; the likelihood escalates to approximately 30% per year upon any missed regulatory deadline, irregular transaction pattern, negative media allegation, or detected inconsistency between the resident-agent records and the central UBO registry.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Company name search and reservation certificate (búsqueda y reserva de denominación social)
Notarization of the articles of incorporation (Pacto Social) and officers' oaths before a Panamanian notary public
Public Registry incorporation filing, name registration, and stamping of corporate books (Sociedad Anónima, nominal share capital payable without minimum paid-in capital requirement)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registration tariff based on declared capital and number of books stamped

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Licensed resident agent and statutory registered office service (first calendar year)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed resident agent (attorney or law firm)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Corporate documentation package: drafting and authorization of bylaws, corporate governance consents, DGI tax registration (RUC), and municipal aviso de operación preparation

Central Beneficial Ownership Registry initial filing and beneficial ownership matrix preparation under Cabinet Decree 511/2019 (25% threshold analysis, UBO identification of all natural persons above threshold)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: SSRF registry fee plus incorporation counsel professional fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory administrative fee plus prevailing professional fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP, sanctions, and adverse-media screening per entity (UN, OFAC, EU, CNV, and FATF/GAFILAT lists; five screened natural persons - UBOs and directors)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed AML compliance screening provider / Panama-qualified compliance officer

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille and legalization certifications for origin-jurisdiction due-diligence documents (passports, certificates of good standing, criminal records)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent apostille authority (home-country ministry or Panamanian Ministry of Foreign Affairs where applicable)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarized and apostilled Power of Attorney to the resident agent, including electronic signature authentication
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Panamanian Notary Public and Ministry of Foreign Affairs

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified Spanish translation and legalization of non-Spanish UBO and corporate documents (where required)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Certified public translator commissioned by the Panamanian courts or notary

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 32 de 1927 (Sociedades Anónimas), as amended by Ley 5 de 1998 and Ley 47 de 2020, Articles 1-43 (formation), 44-63 (directors), 64-77 (shareholders).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Sección Mercantil (Public Registry of Panama, Mercantile Section).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública de Constitución (Public Deed of Incorporation) or Pacto Social Privado (Private Social Pact) filed electronically via the Título de Sociedad platform.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital; capital may be as low as USD 1.00. No escrow account or capital deposit certificate is required. Shares may be issued partly or fully unpaid, subject to the board's call for future installments.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the corporation accepts the subscription of its initial authorized capital by the founding shareholders, and the allocable shares are issued as fully paid or subject to the terms stated in the subscription agreement. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office be and hereby is fixed at [address], Panama, and the resident agent designated by the incorporation filings is confirmed. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the following individuals are appointed officers: [Name] as President, [Name] as Secretary, [Name] as Treasurer, each to serve until the next annual meeting. RESOLVED FINALLY, that the officers are authorized to open bank accounts, execute contracts, and effect all filings required for the company's digital publishing operations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Reserve corporate name and obtain name certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Departamento de Nombres (via online portal 'Panamá Emprende')
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation application with three proposed names in order of preference. The Registry verifies against the existing corporate name database. An official 'Certificado de Aviso' (name certificate) is issued, valid for 30 days.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused or queried, file an appeal with the Director of the Mercantile Section within 3 business days, or submit a new name reservation with a distinct distinctive element.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Draft and notarize the incorporation deed or private pact
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary public in Panama; for private pacts, designation of an incorporating attorney.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the charter in Spanish or bilingual form containing the S.A.'s name, registered office address, resident agent acceptance, corporate purpose (including digital platform development and content licensing), authorized share capital, classes of shares, board structure, and restoration of foreign property rights. Submit to a Panamanian notary for notarization or execute as a private pact before an attorney.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: The notary or attorney may correct inconsistencies through a corrective amendment deed; re-execution is required if the document fails formal attestation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: File incorporation deed with the Public Registry and obtain mercantile registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Sección Mercantil
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the notarized deed or private pact via the online platform 'Sistema de Registro Electrónico (SRE)'. Attach proof of payment of the statutory fee (approximately USD 350). The Registry reviews form and legality, then issues the 'Inscripción de la Sociedad' (certificate of incorporation). This step effectively creates the legal entity.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a 'nota de defecto' (observation), cure the stated defect within 5 business days by filing a corrective amendment, or apply for an extension before the registration expires.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Hold first board meeting and execute written board resolution
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Corporate board / resident agent in Panama
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board of directors (or obtain unanimous written consent) to adopt the Pro-Forma First Board Resolution. The resolution adopts the registered office, appoints officers, approves share issuance considerations, and authorizes opening of bank accounts. Record minutes in the corporate minute book.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a director is unavailable, the meeting may be delayed and a reconvening notice issued; the same resolution may be passed by unanimous written consent without a physical meeting.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Open corporate bank account and obtain standard corporate documentation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Private banks in Panama (e.g., Banco Nacional de Panamá or licensed private banks) with AML compliance departments; Regime of the Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the certified registry certificate, first board resolution, and beneficial ownership declaration to a Panamanian bank to open a corporate account in USD. Complete the due diligence Form, identifying the ultimate beneficial owners and the intended use of payment rails (Apple IAP, Google Play Billing).
required_dossiers: Proof of address of beneficial owners
Bank account application and risk profile questionnaire
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requires additional information, provide a complete corporate organigram and source-of-funds evidence; if rejected, appeal to the bank's compliance committee or apply to a secondary bank.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministerio de Comercio e Industrias (MICI) – Dirección de Empresas
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Aviso de Operación (Business Operation Notice) for digital services – no industrial manufacturing permit required

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente (MiAMBIENTE) – Dirección de Evaluación Ambiental
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – pure digital/electronic publishing without physical manufacturing facilities or waste-generating operations
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable; as a digital content studio with rental or occupied office space, the corporation must comply with municipal solid-waste collection and any local ordinance on electronic equipment disposal. No wastewater or VOC emission thresholds apply.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable for pure digital operations. If a physical studio or office is occupied, the local Municipality ('Dirección de Rentas Municipales') requires a fire safety certificate from the 'Benemérito Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá' and a basic structural occupancy inspection. The Ministry of Labour's 'Dirección de Higiene Ocupacional' will verify workspace safety and emergency exit signage when employees are hired in Panama.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP) as the prudential banking and financial conduct regulator; Banco Nacional de Panamá acts as fiscal agent of the Republic of Panama but is not a central bank of issue. Panama has no monetary authority equivalent to a traditional central bank.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Panama is a fully dollarised jurisdiction; the balboa is only a coin surrogate and actual clearing is conducted in U.S. dollars. There are no statutory exchange controls on either current or capital account transactions, no prior approval for offshore wire transfers, and no currency conversion obligation for remittances. Dividend distributions, profit repatriations, intellectual property licence fees, and intercompany payments in USD are freely permitted, subject to AML/KYC, bank risk acceptance, and proof of underlying economic substance. The only practical hurdles are corporate record validation, accurate tax residence documentation, and compliance with FATF-derived transparency requirements.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. Panama does not impose mandatory surrender, repatriation thresholds, or conversion ratios for export proceeds. Digital webtoon and syndication revenues collected through Apple IAP and Google Play Billing may enter Panama in USD at treasury discretion. For territorial-tax substantiation, PA_CORP must retain platform payout reports, executed licensing and syndication agreements, and bank statements demonstrating that the digital services are provided to non-Panama customers from outside Panama's territorial tax net.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium. Offshore digital EMI solutions such as Wise, Payoneer, and Airwallex are operationally useful for receiving Apple/Google platform payouts and aggregating small-volume cross-border royalties, but they are not licensed Panamanian banks. SBP-regulated law prohibits unlicensed deposit-taking and concentration of treasury funds with an unlicensed EMI; therefore EMIs may be used only as pass-through collection rails, with automatic sweeps to a Tier-1 Panamanian bank account. Legal constraints also include EMI reliance on master correspondent banking relationships, which may be terminated without notice, and the absence of SBP depositor protection. EMIs are suitable as a secondary liquidity clearing channel, not as the sole treasury custodian.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote account opening is conditionally permitted for a low-risk digital publishing S.A. when all directors, signatories, and ultimate beneficial owners have verifiable identity documents, the corporation has clean public registry records, and the bank's video-KYC and certification workflow is acceptable. In practice, several Tier-1 banks require at least one physical onboarding interview for a newly formed Panama S.A. with foreign shareholders. Banco General and Banco Nacional may mandate a physical appearance or notarised apostilled power of attorney with an in-person signatory. For the most predictable route, budget for one principal director or a duly empowered officer to attend a Panama City banking interview, while other directors may use remote video KYC where the bank's risk appetite allows.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Newly formed Panama S.A. with opaque ultimate beneficial ownership, no prior financial statements, and possible legacy bearer-share documentation.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide certificate of registered shares from the share register, declaration of ultimate beneficial owners signed before the resident agent, no bearer-share certificates or a confirmation that all bearer shares have been immobilised with a licensed custodian, together with a formal board resolution identifying the economic owner and funding source.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore jurisdiction characterisation as a shell company or PIF abuse risk due to absence of a physical office and employees in Panama.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Submit the registered agent certificate, a co-working or virtual office service agreement, the S.A. constitutive deed, board resolutions, a functional treasury and IP-management narrative, and evidence of substantive operating activities including the webtoon platform agreements, traffic reports, and syndication contracts.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: First inbound capital injection originates from an EMI or from a third-party shareholder not named in the platform payout statements.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide the shareholder's bank statement and source-of-wealth declaration, the original incorporation documents, an executed board resolution approving capital contribution, an equity injection letter, full UBO identification, and an explanation of why the funds passed through an intermediary such as an online payment platform.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Mismatch between declared digital publishing revenue and bank profile when Apple/Google payouts are made in bulk to an overseas payout partner or through a U.S. collection bank.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Assemble the Apple Developer Program and Google Play merchant agreements, App Store Connect payout reports, Google Play financial reports, IP licensing and syndication contracts, royalty calculation spreadsheets for multilingual chapter unlocking, and a reconciliation statement linking each bank receipt to the relevant platform transaction.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Shareholder equity must be transmitted by direct SWIFT/CHIPS or Fedwire in USD from a regulated bank account in the shareholder's name to PA_CORP's Panamanian dollar account. Panama has no statutory FX purpose code registry, so the bank's remittance instruction should state the ISO 20022 purpose as a capital transfer, with narrative: 'Equity capital injection for PA_CORP — no trade or sanctions exposure'. The bank may require the underlying judicial or corporate instrument demonstrating authorisation, such as the incorporation deed, the capital increase board minutes, and the updated share registry entry. The transaction must be booked in the company ledger as paid-in capital or share premium, not as income, and the corresponding bank credit note should be preserved for audit and territorial-tax evidence.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Payments to freelance artists, translators, licensors, and software vendors should use SWIFT MT103 for low-to-mid-value transfers, with clear cross-referencing to invoices, contract numbers, and chapter batch identifiers in field 70. For high-value or milestone-based digital content acquisition, an irrevocable commercial letter of credit confirmed by a prime bank may be used, although clean SWIFT transfers are generally operationally superior for webtoon syndication. USD clearing is routed through U.S. correspondent banks via Fedwire or CHIPS; local clearing within Panama follows SBP-regulated settlement. For recurring small remittances to creators, batch ACH or a licensed EMI payout rail is acceptable, but the receiving bank's BIC and beneficiary legal-entity name must exactly match contract documentation.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Vanilla deliverable FX forwards in USD/foreign currencies through SBP-regulated banks
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for liquidity-risk or settlement-risk currencies through licensed international brokers
Cross-currency swaps for multi-year syndication revenue streams where the webtoon platform reports earnings in non-USD major currencies

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Franchise Tax on Juridical Persons (Tasa Anual de Personas Jurídicas)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) — Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas / national bank payment portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due by 31 March of each calendar year; no extension for standard corporations
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Automatic late charge of USD 50 for payments made after 31 March; continued non-payment for three consecutive years permits administrative strike-off by the Registro Público upon DGI instruction; reactivation requires full payment plus judicial and registry fees.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return (Declaración Jurada de Renta)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) — Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due within three months after the corporation's fiscal year-end; for calendar-year entities, by 31 March of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing fine equal to 10% of the due tax (minimum USD 50); monthly interest on unpaid tax at the applicable DGI rate; persistent non-filing enables DGI to issue official assessments and impose record-keeping penalties.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Resident Agent Annual Registration Confirmation and UBO Record Refresh
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registro Público de Panamá, through the licensed resident agent (law firm)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No fixed government filing deadline; must be maintained continuously throughout the corporate lifecycle and updated within any event-driven interval (e.g., share transfer or director change)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain accurate resident-agent and beneficial-ownership records under Ley 23 de 2015 exposes the company to fines up to USD 1,000,000 and restriction of corporate benefits; the Registry can refuse certificates of good standing if the agent is not on record.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Independent audit by a licensed Panamanian public accountant is mandatory when gross income from Panamanian sources exceeds USD 1,000,000 per fiscal year or total assets exceed USD 2,000,000; below these thresholds, the corporation may be exempt from audited financial statements for tax-filing purposes.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as issued by the IASB for public-interest entities and listed companies; other juridical persons may use IFRS for SMEs; tax compliance requires financial statements prepared on the territorial-source basis under Panama's Código Fiscal.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under Ley 23 de 2015, the resident agent must hold a current ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) file, but no annual re-filing with the Registry is required. After any direct or indirect shareholding transfer, the resident agent must update the UBO ledger within the legally required period and record the transfer in the corporation's Register of Shareholders. Bearer shares are subject to mandatory immobilization with a designated custodian; the custodian's records serve as the UBO register.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Corporate Holding Transactions / Share Ledger

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 0 – 1,500 if below audit threshold; USD 4,000 – 12,000 if audited financial statements are required
